jobs.description: About GFGlobalFoundries (GF) is a leading manufacturer of essential semiconductors that enable AI at scale, from the cloud to the physical world. We partner closely with our customers to deliver differentiated, power-efficient, high-performance solutions for high-growth markets. Across our global footprint in the United States, Europe and Asia, our teams are solving complex challenges that shape the future of technology. At GF, you'll find the opportunity to make an impact, work with world-class talent and contribute to a more secure, sustainable future.Your JobIn semiconductor manufacturing, no processing machine runs continuously yielding the same results. Materials used in the machine can degrade over time, simple factors like –outside temperature can fluctuate, and high usage and low usage play a roll. For stable process results, specific machine settings and recipe parameters are tuned automatically or manually. This is an essential part of work for our process and equipment experts.As a PhD candidate, you will be looking differently at our machines and processes. You already have a scientist´s or an engineer´s view. You know and see the parameters available, regardless of current usage. There, your journey starts towards finding the optimal machine and process settings with as few as possible latest data points. Latest advances in Machine Learning and Artificial Intelligence indicate the possibility for improvements and will guide your research.The goal of this work shall be the summary and testing of state-of-the-art methods in real-world applications as well as development of new methods tailored to the needs of the semiconductor industry, so in this work Data Science approaches are to be developed to enable process experts to use ML and AI for machine and process tuning.   The contract for this position is set up for 3 years with the possibility to extend it by one additional year, if required. We are looking for a research associate who wants to take a coordinating role in a joint project with other partners from academia and industry and in aligning their research work to the requirements of later mass production. You will systematically document and present the results in regular reports. GF supports the publication of scientific results in leading journals and the protection of intellectual property by the submission of patents.   Required Qualifications- You have completed or are finalizing your Master Thesis in Computer Science, Physics, Chemistry, Mathematics, Electrical Engineering or a comparable research field.- Your passion is to use your scientific knowledge in a cross-functional team together with experts from other sciences and fields of engineering.- You have already developed your own software, but also have high technical understanding capabilities.- You have solid skills in Python and related Machine Learning libraries.- Wrangling and evaluating data is standard for you.- You know how to use state-of-the-art word processing software to document and communicate your results.- You have a high degree of independence and time flexibility and enjoy communication within global teams.- A good command of written and spoken English (C1) completes your profile.Preferred Qualifications- First insights into semiconductor fabrication processes, e.g. deposition, etching etc. are a plus.- Knowledge about state models, digital twins, predictive control or world models, and about control theory are a plus.- Knowledge of Cloud environments, e.g. AWS, is a plus. Start Date2027, 3 years contract with 40h/week work time.Information about our benefits you can find here: hierSchlagworte: Englisch, RF, HF, EmpfehlungsbundQuelle/Bewerbung via: https://www.empfehlungsbund.de/jobs/309367/phd-on-predictive-process-machine-control (https://www.empfehlungsbund.de/jobs/309367/phd-on-predictive-process-machine-control#apply_form)Kurzinfo zum UnternehmenÜber GFGlobalFoundries (GF) ist ein führender Hersteller von Halbleitern, auf die sich die Welt zum Leben, Arbeiten und Vernetzen verlässt. Wir sind innovativ und arbeiten mit unseren Kunden zusammen, um energieeffizientere und leistungsfähigere Produkte für die Automobilindustrie, intelligente mobile Geräte, das Internet der Dinge (IoT), Kommunikationsinfrastrukturen und andere wachstumsstarke Märkte zu entwickeln.Mit unserem globalen Produktionsnetzwerk, das sich über die USA, Europa und Asien erstreckt, sind wir eine vertrauenswürdige und zuverlässige Quelle für Kunden in aller Welt. Jeden Tag liefert unser talentiertes und vielfältiges Team Ergebnisse mit einem unnachgiebigen Fokus auf Sicherheit, Langlebigkeit und Nachhaltigkeit. GF beschäftigt weltweit rund 13.000 Mitarbeitende, davon 3.000 in Dresden. Weitere Informationen finden Sie unter www.gf.com.

About us European Semiconductor Manufacturing Company (ESMC) GmbH isthe joint venture between TSMC, Bosch, Infineon and NXP. For the firsttime, global technology leader TSMC is building a semiconductor fab inthe heart of Europe, offering cutting-edge manufacturing technologiesfor next-generation semiconductor products. ESMC represents a sharedcommitment to strengthening the European semiconductor ecosystem. Forour future fab in Dresden, we are looking for a highly motivated andcommitted: Hardware Engineer (m/w/d) Become the heart of our fabautomation. The Automated Material Handling System (AMHS) will be thenervous system of our fab. As an AMHS Hardware Engineer, you’ll be atechnical expert, designer, problem-solver, and team leader. You’llensure that our wafer transport systems (transfer tools, sorters, N2systems) operate at maximum efficiency. Tasks You will be responsiblefor the installation, commissioning, and continuous improvement of ourAMHS hardware. For complex issues, you will conduct root causeanalyses (8D, FMEA, SPC) and implement sustainable solutions. You willlead cross-functional projects aimed at improving productivity,quality, and cost efficiency—from planning through to performancereview. You will evaluate new equipment and materials, work closelywith suppliers, and develop in-house hardware solutions to meetoperational needs. You will lead and mentor a team of technicians andjunior engineers, share your knowledge, and foster team spirit throughclear communication. You will actively assist with installation andcoordinate upgrades in close collaboration with other departments.Profile You are a proactive team player who thrives in a dynamic,fast-paced environment and is willing to take on responsibility. AMaster’s degree in Engineering, such as Mechanical or ElectricalEngineering, Automation, or a related field. Professional experiencein the semiconductor industry is required. In-depth knowledge ofoptimization algorithms, control systems, and mechanical automation.Proficiency in quality tools such as SPC, FMEA, and 8Dproblem-solving. Hands-on mentality, resilience, and the ability tomotivate and lead teams professionally. Fluent in English (companylanguage). Basic communication skills in Mandarin or German is a plus.Available for on-the-job training in Taiwan, 9 to 12 months. We offerSecurity & Perspective: A permanent employment contract and careeradvancement opportunities in one of Europe's leading semiconductorsfabs. Company Pension Plan & Financial Benefits: We support yourfinancial well-being with our robust company pension plan. As an ESMCemployee, you also benefit directly from TSMC’s performance throughan exclusive Employee Stock Purchase Plan (ESPP). Relocation Supportfor Dresden: Moving for us? We’ll provide you with all the supportyou will need for your relocation and your start in Dresden. Training& Development: Depending on your position, you will gain a deeperunderstanding of the processes involved in operating complexsemiconductor equipment through unique hands-on training at the TSMCNewcomer Training Center, while continuously expanding your knowledge.Health & Well-Being: An annual budget for your health and well-being(e.g., for sports classes, massages, or relaxation) helps you stayfit. Meals & Transportation: Enjoy a daily meal allowance as well as asubsidized public transportation (e.g., for the Deutschlandticket) inGermany. Additional contact details Please apply with your Englishresume.

jobs.occupation: Head of Production (m/f/d) – Honext x WEPA (Produktmanager/in)
jobs.description: What you can expect About Honext x WEPA Honext x WEPA GmbH is a new joint venture between two family businesses: Honext Material (Barcelona), a pioneer in circular building materials, and the WEPA Group (Arnsberg), one of Europe's leading hygiene paper producers with more than 4,500 employees at 15 sites.Together we are building a new production plant in Kriebstein, Saxony , right next to WEPA's paper mill. There we turn fibres recovered from waste paper recycling into HONEXT® fibreboards : resin-free, lightweight, fire-retardant, acoustically strong and fully recyclable at end of life. The boards are Cradle to Cradle Certified® Gold and used in interior design, wall and ceiling cladding, acoustic panels and furniture.The project is backed by the European Investment Bank. Now we need the person who turns it into a running plant. Your mission You build it. As Head of Production you are one of the first leaders in a start-up with the backing of two established industrial partners. You lead the plant from project phase to steady operation: you drive the build-up, coordinate everyone involved, make the calls and grow the team that will run Europe's next circular fibreboard plant.This is not a role for administering what exists. It is for someone who wants to own the result, think like an entrepreneur and see their decisions turn into a working factory. What you'll do• Lead people: Hire, lead and develop the production team from day one. You set the tone for a culture of ownership, collaboration and high performance.• Drive the build-up: Push the plant project forward with drive and pace, from ramp-up to stable series production, and turn plans into results.• Coordinate the project: Act as the central link between project management, engineering, technology suppliers, authorities and both shareholders, Honext and WEPA.• Make decisions: Take responsibility for critical decisions on safety, environment, quality and operations, and stand behind them.• Build structures: Set up lean processes, standards and KPIs that make the plant efficient and competitive from the start.• Own the numbers: Take responsibility for production budget, costs and performance, and improve them continuously.• Represent the plant: Negotiate and communicate confidently in English with international partners, suppliers and the team in Barcelona.What we expect from you Must-haves• Several years of leadership experience in production, ideally as plant or production manager, with a track record of leading and developing teams.• Experience in driving projects and coordinating many stakeholders at once.• Business fluent English, confident enough to negotiate.• A degree in engineering (e.g. mechanical, process or production engineering, industrial engineering) or a comparable qualification.Big pluses• Experience in the paper industry, or in related fields such as pulp, board, wood-based panels or furniture.• Start-up experience or experience building up a plant, line or organisation from scratch.Who you are• You want to build something and you identify with what you build: circular production, made in Saxony.• You are driven, hands-on and want to carry responsibility.• You think like an entrepreneur: you weigh costs, risks and opportunities and decide.• You lead with clarity and stay calm and solution-oriented when things move fast.What we offer you• Real impact: Shape structures, processes and the team of a new plant from the very beginning.• Start-up spirit with industrial backing: Short decision paths and high autonomy, combined with the expertise and resources of Honext and WEPA.• A product with purpose: Help scale a circular material that turns paper industry residues into high-quality boards.• Growth: A role that grows with the company, with room for professional and personal development.• International setting: Close collaboration with teams in Germany and Spain.Ready to build it with us? We look forward to your application.About usWe are PeopleX. We bring together people who fit professionally and culturally.We are an in-house as well as external HR consultancy specializing in supporting small and medium-sized enterprises. Our goal is to find, develop, and retain employees who fit both professionally and culturally, to shape a successful and sustainable future collaboratively.
